This directory contains shaders from external sources that we use for
benchmarking Tint. Each sub-directory contains a set of shaders from a
single source, with their own LICENSE.

## unity_boat_attack

These shaders are taken from the [unity_web_research
repository](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/unity_web_research). The
shaders are provided with an MIT license and modified to replace the
`UNITY_RUNTIME_INSTANCING_ARRAY_SIZE` placeholder string with an
actual numeric value.
